name: orchestrator
description: Technology-agnostic AI SDLC orchestrator — cross-repo pipelines, grounded context, blocking quality gates, enforced token budgets, and auto-learning memory
_componentDeclaration: Only skills and commands are declared, and both as ARRAYS OF DIRECTORIES rather than file lists — so adding a skill never requires editing this manifest, which matters for a generated content plane. Agents are deliberately absent: the Claude Code plugin validator REJECTS an `agents` key outright with the opaque error `agents: Invalid input`, and agent files under agents/ are auto-discovered by convention. Hooks are absent for the same class of reason — see hooks/hooks.json. validate-structure.py fails the build if either key reappears here.
_mcpServersNote: An explicit empty object, not an omission. It opts out of auto-loading a repo-root .mcp.json, and it keeps generated MCP tool names short: a long plugin slug plus a server plus a tool can exceed the 64-character limit that strict gateways enforce. This is also why the plugin is named `orchestrator` rather than `ai-orchestrator-hub`.

hooks_enabled.title: Enable orchestrator hooks
hooks_enabled.description: Runs the fact-forcing gate, config protection, prompt-defense scanning, destructive-command gating, citation auditing, and learning capture. Disable to keep skills and agents without any local automation.

hook_profile.title: Hook profile
hook_profile.description: minimal (lifecycle bookkeeping only) | standard (adds quality and grounding gates) | strict (adds everything). An invalid value falls back to standard rather than to off.

quality_gate_threshold.title: Quality gate threshold
quality_gate_threshold.description: Minimum score (0-100) a pipeline phase must reach before the pipeline advances.

grounding_enabled.title: Grounding evidence manifest
grounding_enabled.description: Verify referenced files and symbols against the structural graph before a skill runs, and hand the model an EXISTS / NOT FOUND manifest.

org_profile.title: Overlay profile
org_profile.description: Must match a folder under overlays/. Org-specific content is merged over the neutral content plane at sync time.
